Same-mechanism finding for this card, from the L1 read of PR #37595 (card #37503), 2026-11-26T15:39Z. Filed here rather than as a new card (filing gate: open, unclaimed card, same mechanism).

- What: `content/docs/getting-started/build-with-claude-code.mdx` section 3 teaches the ticket view with an internal create/edit `form:` member in its `defineView` container (main ~209-219), and then says "the form is where the long-text `description` is entered and shown" (~260-262). The Console no longer loads that form (`packages/lint/src/validate-internal-form-views.ts` header, #36425), so the sentence is false on today's Console.
- Evidence: the #37503 dev's real `os compile` of the page's verbatim ticket files on head 95d0446c0 prints one `form-view-internal-not-loaded` warning (os-dev report on #37503, `out_of_scope_findings`). PR #37595's `cli.mdx` callout now states that warning beside the transcript.
- Why here: item 4's Done-when grep (`formViews|viewKind: 'form'`) does not match a `form:` member of a `defineView` container on a docs page. The rewrite owes this page as well, and the grep alone will not find it.
- Overlap: open PR #37422 (#37086) edits this page, but only the rule count in the validate transcript; it does not touch the form.
- Suggested grade: unchanged (p2). It is the newcomer tutorial, but nothing breaks: the record page lays out by `fieldGroups`.
